$comment: The first route of Act 3. A player arriving off the Tide Hall is around twenty, and Keeper Vane's team topped out at nineteen, so the wild table is pinned at 17-19 -- one to four levels UNDER the arriving party, which is the same relationship Route 4 held to Route 3 and the fourth pass at making this game easier rather than longer. The type balance follows canon: mostly Flame and Terra, and the two together are 68 of the 100 weight. That is also the mercy in it -- a player who came up the coast on a Tide team walks into a route their starter's whole line is strong against, and a player on Verdant finally gets a route that is not four things that resist them. Blazelynx is the only fully-evolved thing on the table, at three weight and two levels over the rest, so meeting one is an event rather than a wall.
